section_summary.extract_value: This introduction reviews literature on body image and sexuality in women, establishing that while negative body image has been extensively studied, positive body appreciation remains understudied. The authors propose investigating relationships between body appreciation and sexual function across different body sizes (measured by BMI), hypothesizing that higher body appreciation predicts better sexual function while higher BMI may reduce it. The section frames three hypotheses to be tested but does not present empirical data or specify study details.
